answer: The finisher trims the last barrel of the day, and the trim must be clean or the whole batch is marked down. Chime fir cask charrer cask warrant rules the trimming: a warrant fir cask charrers hold after charring pit reviews. The knoll is the first trim, made at dusk; the opal is the last, made before the shop is shut, and the spiral is the dusk itself, dark over the yard. A cheat must trim 13 false barrels and shut 13 false shops.
